Self.Wiki: This map object represents a form of collision. Typically used to block player or enemy movement, but also used for detection such as for kill planes, or the generation of special footstep visual effects, such as in water or lava.

HitFilterID.Wiki: Determines the behavior of the collision with other entities.

LocationTextID.Wiki: ID of location text to display when stepping onto this collision.

PlayRegionID.Wiki: The play region while standing on this collision. -1 on every collision in the game files.

OutdoorIndoorType.Wiki: Sound space while standing on this collision: 0 outdoor, 1 half indoor, 2 fully indoor (Wwise OutdoorIndoor states). -1 keeps the default.

EasyOcclusionID.Wiki: Wwise EasyOcclusionID state (_N) while standing on this collision.

PlayerLightScale.Wiki: Overrides the map's Player Light Scale (MapDefaultInfoParam) while standing on this collision. Negative keeps the map's value.

TimezonePlayerLightScaleOverride.Wiki: Overrides MapDefaultInfoParam Is Enable Timezone Player Light Scale while standing on this collision: 1 on, 2 off, 0 keeps the map's value.

OpenChrActivateThreshold.Wiki: Overrides MapDefaultInfoParam Open Chr Activate Threshold while standing on this collision. Negative keeps the map's value.

GparamOverride.Wiki: Overrides the gparam with this sub ID: it replaces BB in mXX_XX_AABB. -1 for none. Assets on this collision use it unless they override their gparam settings.

Unk04.Wiki: Read by the game through the assets that use this collision's settings. 0 on most collisions, else 64.81, 92.33, 100.98 or 2.4.

Unk1C.Wiki: Read by the game. In Elden Ring, a second place name text ID. -1 on all but one collision.

Unk26.Wiki: Read by the game through the assets that use this collision's settings. ON for 39 collisions.

Unk34.Wiki: Read by the game. 0 or 2 in the game files.

Unk3C.Wiki: Read by the game through the assets that use this collision's settings. -1 on all but two collisions (10000).

UnkT4C.Wiki: Read by the game. 0 in the game files. In Elden Ring, 1 or 2 shift a threshold for the character standing on the collision.

Option.Name: Trigger fall death camera on collision
